items.evidence: src/Dto/SubscribeRequest.php:9-15 — `#[Assert\NotBlank] #[Assert\Email] public string $email` and `#[Assert\NotBlank] #[Assert\Choice(choices: ['basic', 'pro'])] public string $plan`
